title: Bootcamp 2027
text:
About
This site documents and describes the 2027 Open Scholarship Bootcamp to be held on the University Park campus of the Pennsylvania State University Monday, May 10 and Tuesday, May 11, 2027.

title: Bootcamp 2027
text:
Goals

To create a focal point for activity and learning related to open scholarship practices.
To accelerate the development of a community of scholars who are interested in open scholarship.
To plan next steps that will foster the emergence of a robust open scholarship community at Penn State.







ImportantTo register



Visit < https://forms.gle/45EXJomr5yu6DHq19>.

title: Bootcamp 2027
text:
Location
The Bootcamp will be held at the Pattee and Paterno Libraries on the Penn State University Park campus. The Dewey Room on Ground floor of the Collaboration Commons in (W043) Pattee Library is the principal location.
